title: Coordenador(a) de Sucesso do Cliente - Campinas/SP
description:
Procuramos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Sucesso do Cliente para liderar a estratégia de Customer Success, garantindo retenção, expansão e excelência no atendimento à base de clientes. Essa pessoa será responsável por estruturar e padronizar processos, além de desenvolver e liderar o time de consultores.

Todas as nossas vagas estão disponíveis para pessoas com deficiência!

Que tal se juntar ao nosso time e embarcar nessa jornada com a gente?

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES:

  • Liderar a estratégia de Sucesso do Cliente, garantindo retenção, engajamento e crescimento da base.
  • Gerir e desenvolver o time de consultores de Customer Success, promovendo alta performance e evolução contínua.
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores-chave (NPS, Churn, MRR, Health Score,
  • Acompanhamento Evolutivo), transformando dados em ações práticas.
  • Estruturar e padronizar processos de Customer Success, garantindo escala e consistência.
  • Atuar de forma consultiva junto aos clientes estratégicos, entendendo necessidades e propondo soluções de valor.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de retenção, redução de churn e expansão de receita (upsell e cross-sell).
  • Garantir rentabilidade da carteira de clientes da unidade.
  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com áreas como Comercial, Produto e Implantação.
  • Realizar visitas a clientes, fortalecendo relacionamento e geração de valor.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES:

  • Experiência sólida em Customer Success, com domínio de metodologias da área;
  • Vivência prática na gestão de indicadores como Churn, NRR, NPS e Health Score;
  • Experiência em gestão de pessoas e desenvolvimento de times;
  • Conhecimento em ERP e regras de negócio;
  • Disponibilidade para mobilidade entre Ribeirão Preto e Campinas, incluindo interação frequente com clientes e times locais.

Diferencial:

  • Experiência com padronização ou reestruturação de processos.

title: Analista de Supply Chain pleno
description:
A Hunter Douglas, multinacional centenária e líder em cortinas, persianas e soluções arquitetônicas, agora parte do portfólio da 3G Capital, está em busca de novos talentos que queiram fazer parte de uma jornada de inovação e crescimento.

Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar como Analista de Supply Chain Pleno, gerindo processos de compras nacionais e internacionais com foco em eficiência, prazos e custos, acompanhando todo o fluxo de suprimentos e atuando na melhoria contínua de processos e indicadores. Se você tem perfil analítico, organizado e gosta de estruturar processos com responsabilidade, essa oportunidade é pra você.

Posição: Analista de Supply Chain Pleno

Atribuições:

  • Realizar o planejamento Savings de compras buscando otimização de processos, prospecção de fornecedores e materiais.
  • Executar processos de compras nacionais e importadas, assegurando compliance e prazos.
  • Controlar follow-up de pedidos e acompanhar prazos de produção, embarque e desembaraço.
  • Atuar em iniciativas de redução de custo e otimização de lead time.
  • Acompanhar o fluxo inbound de matérias-primas, garantindo sincronismo com a produção.
  • Interface com transportadoras, operadores logísticos e parceiros estratégicos.
  • Atuar em projetos de automação de processos, dashboards, RPA, e melhorias sistêmicas (ERP/MES/WMS).
  • Identificar oportunidades de eficiência e simplificação na cadeia.
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho: OTIF, SLA de entrega, nível de serviço, forecast accuracy, lead time, cobertura de estoques.

Critérios:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Logística, Supply Chain ou áreas correlatas.
  • Atuação de, no mínimo, 2 anos na área de Supply Chain.
  • Experiência em operações envolvendo compras internacionais e logística integrada.

Diferenciais:

  • Vivência com modelo Make to Order.
  • Inglês e/ou espanhol.
  • Experiência em companhias multinacionais.

title: Comunidade De Talentos Kenvue – Pessoas Com Deficiência (Pcd)
description:
Kenvue is currently recruiting for a:

Comunidade de Talentos Kenvue – Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD)

What we do

At Kenvue, we realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. Built on over a century of heritage and rooted in science, we’re the house of iconic brands - including NEUTROGENA®, AVEENO®, TYLENOL®, LISTERINE®, JOHNSON’S® and BAND-AID® that you already know and love. Science is our passion;
care is our talent.

Who We Are

Our global team is ~ 22,000 brilliant people with a workplace culture where every voice matters, and every contribution is appreciated. We are passionate about insights, innovation and committed to delivering the best products to our customers. With expertise and empathy, being a Kenvuer means having the power to impact millions of people every day. We put people first, care fiercely, earn trust with science and solve with courage – and have brilliant opportunities waiting for you! Join us in shaping our future–and yours. For more information , click here.

Role reports to:

LIDER REG REC E SELECAO

Location:

Latin America, Brazil, Sao Paulo, Sao Paulo

Work Location:

Hybrid

What you will do

Comunidade de Talentos Kenvue – Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD)

Local: Brasil
Departamento: Vários
Regime de contratação: Inclusão - Período integral

O que nós fazemos

Na Kenvue, reconhecemos o poder extraordinário do cuidado diário. Com mais de um século de tradição e com foco na ciência, somos o lar de marcas icônicas – como NEUTROGENA®, LISTERINE®, TYLENOL®, JOHNSON’S BABY® e BAND-AID® – que você já conhece e ama. A ciência é a nossa paixão;
o cuidado, o nosso talento.

Quem somos

Nosso time global é formado por ~ 22.000 pessoas brilhantes, em uma cultura na qual cada voz importa e toda contribuição é valorizada. Somos movidos por insights, inovação e pelo compromisso de entregar os melhores produtos aos nossos consumidores. Com expertise e empatia, ser um Kenvuer é ter o poder de impactar milhões de vidas todos os dias. Colocamos as pessoas em primeiro lugar, cuidamos com paixão, ganhamos confiança por meio da ciência e resolvemos com coragem — e temos oportunidades incríveis esperando por você! Junte-se a nós para construir o nosso futuro — e o seu.

Sobre a Comunidade de Talentos PCD Kenvue

Na Kenvue, todas as nossas vagas já são abertas para todas as pessoas! Temos o compromisso de promover um ambiente inclusivo e acolhemos candidaturas de quem quer fazer parte da nossa jornada de cuidado diário.

A Comunidade de Talentos PCD Kenvue é uma iniciativa complementar, especialmente para fortalecer nossa conexão com pessoas com deficiência que queiram desenvolver suas carreiras conosco. Ao se inscrever aqui, você entra para a nossa Comunidade de Talentos Para Pessoas Com Deficiência, e o nosso time de Recrutamento entrará em contato com você sempre que existirem vagas alinhadas às suas experiências, interesses e objetivos de carreira.

O que você vai fazer

O seu perfil será considerado para funções na Kenvue de acordo com as suas experiências, interesses e habilidades. Temos posições em diferentes áreas e senioridades nos escritórios de São Paulo e São José dos Campos/SP, vagas virtuais e posições de campo em todo Brasil.

Qualificações mínimas:
  • Ensino superior completo
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas digitais (pacote Office)
  • Vontade de crescer e aprender em ambientes operacionais e administrativos
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação e de trabalho em equipe
  • Compromisso em manter um ambiente de trabalho seguro e de alta qualidade
Qualificações desejáveis:
  • Experiência prévia em campos relevantes
  • Inglês avançado
Por que fazer parte da nossa Comunidade de Talentos PCD
  • Pacote de Benefícios Competitivo*
  • Feriados pagos pela empresa, férias remuneradas, tempo para voluntariado e muito mais!
  • Oportunidades de Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento
  • Redes de Impacto da Kenvue

*Essa lista pode variar de acordo com a localização e modelo de trabalho.

Nota: Total Rewards da Kenvue inclui salário, bônus (quando aplicável) e benefícios. Seu parceiro de Talent Access poderá compartilhar mais detalhes sobre nosso pacote completo de recompensas e a faixa salarial específica para a(s) localidade(s) relevante(s) durante o processo de recrutamento e contratação.

A Kenvue tem orgulho de ser uma empregadora que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Todas as pessoas qualificadas que se candidatarem serão considerados para as vagas independentemente de raça, cor, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, idade, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

If you are an individual with a disability, please check our Disability Assistance page for information on how to request an accommodation.

title: Consultor de vendas
description:
Vendedor(a) de Veículos | Átria Veículos — Campinas

title: Assistente / Analista de GRC Júnior
description:
Você é apaixonado por GRC, processos, organização e melhoria contínua?


A Alefra está crescendo e queremos trazer para o time uma pessoa com vontade de aprender, curiosidade, disciplina e interesse real por Governança, Riscos, Compliance, Controles Internos, Auditoria e Certificações ISO.


Na Alefra, acreditamos que GRC não precisa ser burocrático. Nosso trabalho é transformar governança, riscos e compliance em instrumentos práticos para gerar clareza, eficiência, segurança e resultado para os clientes.


Essa vaga é para quem gosta de estruturar, documentar, analisar, organizar evidências, entender processos e apoiar projetos que ajudam empresas a crescer com mais controle e maturidade.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Apoiar projetos de GRC, compliance, riscos e controles internos
  • Organizar políticas, evidências, documentos e planos de ação
  • Apoiar diagnósticos, mapeamento de processos e análise de riscos
  • Participar de projetos de ISO, LGPD, auditoria e governança
  • Elaborar relatórios, apresentações e materiais de acompanhamento
  • Apoiar o relacionamento com clientes e a rotina dos projetos


O que buscamos:

  • Interesse genuíno por GRC, compliance, auditoria, riscos e processos
  • Boa escrita, organização e atenção aos detalhes
  • Vontade de aprender e crescer em consultoria
  • Conhecimento básico em Excel, Google Workspace ou Microsoft Office
  • Formação ou curso em Administração, Direito, Contabilidade, TI, Segurança da Informação, Gestão de Riscos ou áreas correlatas


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em LGPD, ISO 27001, ISO 9001, ISO 20000-1, ISO 42001 ou controles internos
  • Experiência com políticas, procedimentos, auditorias, indicadores ou processos
  • Inglês técnico


Mais do que experiência, valorizamos postura, responsabilidade, curiosidade e vontade de construir.

Modelo: Remoto

Nível: Júnior

title: Especialista de Redes
description:
About Atos


Atos is a global leader in digital transformation with 107,000 employees and annual revenue of over € 11 billion. European number one in cybersecurity, cloud and high performance computing, the Group provides tailored end-to-end solutions for all industries in 71 countries. A pioneer in decarbonization services and products, Atos is committed to a secure and decarbonized digital for its clients. Atos is a SE (Societas Europaea), listed on Euronext Paris and included in the CAC 40 ESG and Next 20 Paris Stock indexes.


The purpose of Atos is to help design the future of the information space. Its expertise and services support the development of knowledge, education, and research in a multicultural approach and contribute to the development of scientific and technological excellence. Across the world, the Group enables its customers and employees, and members of societies at large to live, work and develop sustainably, in a safe and secure information space.


#WE'REHIRING


Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista de Redes para atuar em um ambiente corporativo de grande porte, com foco em redes enterprise, data center e segurança. Procuramos um profissional com forte base técnica, perfil hands-on e visão estratégica, capaz de atuar desde o desenho até a sustentação de soluções de rede.


Modelo de Contratação

  • Cooperativa


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como especialista técnico em redes, apoiando projetos, operações e troubleshooting avançado.
  • Desenhar, implementar e dar suporte a infraestruturas de rede LAN, WAN e Data Center.
  • Definir e validar arquiteturas de rede (HLD e LLD).
  • Administrar e otimizar ambientes de switching e routing em nível enterprise.
  • Atuar na configuração e sustentação de soluções de segurança de redes (firewalls, VPNs e políticas de segurança).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas internas, stakeholders e fornecedores, como referência técnica da área.
  • Apoiar projetos de melhoria, migração e evolução da infraestrutura de redes.
  • Documentar topologias, configurações e procedimentos técnicos.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida como Especialista de Redes / Network Engineer Sênior .
  • Forte domínio em Routing : BGP, OSPF, ISIS, MPLS e SD-WAN.
  • Forte domínio em Switching : VLAN, Trunk, STP/MSTP, LACP, HSRP/VRRP, VPC e ACI.
  • Experiência com Segurança de Redes :
  • Firewalls (Cisco ASA, Fortinet e/ou Palo Alto)
  • VPN, IPsec e controle de acesso
  • Experiência prática em ambientes Data Center e redes corporativas de médio/grande porte .
  • Vivência com fabricantes como Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet e F5 .
  • Experiência em troubleshooting avançado e ambientes críticos.
  • Inglês técnico (mínimo intermediário).
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em Campinas/SP .
  • Disponibilidade para contratação via Cooperativa .


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com ambientes híbridos (on‑premises + cloud – AWS e/ou Azure).
  • Conhecimento em automação de redes (Ansible, Python ou ferramentas similares).
  • Certificações como CCNA, CCNP, JNCIA, JNCIP ou equivalentes .
  • Experiência prévia em grandes empresas, data centers ou provedores de serviços.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.

title: Risk management officer
description:
About Us
Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.
Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.
As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.
Key Responsibilities:
Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
Net-worth monitoring;
Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.
Requirements:
Legally resident in Brazil.
Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function. Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements. Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English . Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Engenheiro de dados sênior
description:
Sobre a Volpi
Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário . O desafio
Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.
Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.
Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership , tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.
O que você vai fazer: Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS; Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance ; Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio; Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados; Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.
O que esperamos de você: Experiência sólida como Data Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev); Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção; Experiência prática com AWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM; Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C) ; Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
Forte preocupação com segurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia; Experiência em ambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero; Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.
Será considerado um diferencial:
Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;

title: Technical product owner
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.
Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.
Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.
Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.
THE ROLE
We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.

What You’ll Do
Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature Co
Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.
 
Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.
Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.
Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.
Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.
Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia
Submission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

• Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.
• AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X)
• Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).
• Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.
• Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.
• Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Technical recruiter (remote)
description:
About Reboot Monkey
Reboot Monkey is a global datacenter services provider headquartered in Haarlem, Netherlands, operating 24 green-powered facilities across 6 continents . We deliver colocation, IP transit, smart hands, remote hands, and managed datacenter services to clients worldwide. We are a lean, remote-first team building the infrastructure backbone of the internet. Our clients range from hyperscalers and carriers to enterprises and startups who need reliable, fast datacenter operations — 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
About the Role
Reboot Monkey operates 24 datacenter facilities across 6 continents. Every one of those facilities needs reliable, skilled Data Center Technicians (DCTs) who can execute Smart Hands and Remote Hands work to our standard. The quality of our DCT pool is the single biggest factor determining whether clients stay or leave.
As DCT Recruitment Specialist for the Asia-Pacific — covering India, Southeast Asia, East Asia, and Oceania , your job is to build and maintain a world-class DCT pool in your region. You are not a generic recruiter — you need to deeply understand what makes a great datacenter technician . You know the difference between someone who can rack a server properly and someone who will strip a screw on the first try. This role requires someone who has either worked as a DCT or managed DCTs directly . You must know the work inside and out — structured cabling, cross-connects, hardware installs, decommissions, labeling standards, hot/cold aisle management. What You'll Do
Source, screen, and recruit Data Center Technicians across facilities in the APAC region
Conduct technical screening interviews — assess hands-on DC skills, not just resume keywords
Build and maintain a vetted DCT pool organized by location, skill level, availability, and reliability score
Verify technician credentials: certifications, references, and work history
Create and maintain DCT skill assessments and practical evaluation criteria
Coordinate onboarding of new DCTs: facility access, safety protocols, SOP training
Track DCT performance after deployment — build a feedback loop with the operations team
Continuously expand our DCT coverage to new markets and facilities in your region
Manage relationships with DCT staffing agencies where we use them
Maintain our DCT database with up-to-date availability, skills, and performance ratings
Requirements
3+ years of recruiting, talent acquisition, or team staffing experience (formal or informal — managing a DCT pool counts)
Ability to conduct technical interviews and assess hands-on datacenter skills
Knowledge of DC infrastructure: structured cabling, server racking, cross-connects, PDUs, environmental monitoring
Fluent written and spoken English
Organized and detail-oriented — managing a regional DCT database requires precision
Comfortable using spreadsheets, databases, or ATS tools to track candidates

title: Fx trader
description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.

Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.
Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization . Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.
Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .
Market Development
Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.
Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .
Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .
Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments . Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks . Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations . Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources . Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies . Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations . Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments
Vision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Estágio em customer success - relacionamento
description:
Na Chuva, a gente acredita que estágio deve formar, não só ocupar.
Por isso, a nossa proposta é simples: trabalho real, aprendizado prático, feedback diário e autonomia conquistada.
A gente fala disso desse jeito porque boa parte do mercado ainda funciona na lógica do “drenar” (brain drain ): promete desenvolvimento, mas entrega só o mínimo necessário para manter você girando. Nós construímos o oposto disso: Brain Bridges (Pontes de Conhecimento). Você traz energia, iniciativa, curiosidade e vontade de aprender com o estágio. Nós entramos com 18 anos de experiência em uma empresa de tecnologia independente, contato direto com os fundadores, acompanhamento e um ambiente seguro para você testar, errar, ajustar e evoluir.
Nosso trabalho impulsiona a ciência apoiando mais de 800 mil pesquisadores no mundo com o Galoá, plataforma que viabiliza o Proceedings Science , o maior acervo de acesso aberto de eventos científicos do Brasil. Se você busca um estágio convencional, o mercado oferece muitas opções. Mas, se você quer uma experiência intensa de aprendizado prático, com tecnologia, responsabilidade e impacto real, seu lugar pode ser aqui.
O que é o Programa de Estágio - Gerente de Si? Trabalhar com propósito exige mais autoconhecimento, autonomia e maturidade profissional. A nossa resposta é: como se aprende isso na prática?
Na Chuva, transformamos esse desafio em formação concreta. Chamamos isso de Gerente de Si, um jeito de garantir a evolução contínua a partir do programa de estágio:
Organização: planejar a própria semana.
Priorização: entender o que precisa ser feito primeiro.
Levantar a mão: pedir ajuda cedo, sem esconder dificuldades.
Accountability: mostrar o andamento do trabalho sem ninguém precisar cobrar.
Maturidade: ouvir e dar feedback sem levar para o lado pessoal.
Autonomia: usar tecnologia para trabalhar melhor, não só mais rápido. É isso que você vai aprender e praticar aqui ao longo do estágio.
Nem tudo será glamouroso. Haverá tarefas operacionais e repetitivas, porque consistência também forma repertório. Ao mesmo tempo, você terá contato com IA, melhoria de processos e problemas reais de uma empresa em movimento. Na trilha de Estágio em Customer Success - Relacionamento você vai atuar principalmente em quatro frentes: Comunicação Estratégica com clientes: Triagem, leitura e envio de e-mails, apoiando a gestão de projetos e relacionamento com os pesquisadores de diferentes países com uma comunicação clara, respeitosa e educativa. Uso de IA e configuração de soluções: Apoio em setups, identificação de padrões e oportunidades de melhoria da qualidade de software, resolução de dúvidas recorrentes e treinamento de bots que otimizem a experiência do cliente (customer experience). Precisão de dados e processos: Higienização e importação de dados com alto nível de cuidado, reduzindo erros e retrabalho na área de suporte. Projetos de melhoria de processos: Resolução de pequenos desafios reais com nossa supervisão, buscando deixar processos mais simples, rápidos e confiáveis. Requirements O que pode te frustrar aqui: Somos 100% transparentes sobre os nossos desafios para você saber onde está mergulhando: As coisas mudam rápido: Não somos uma empresa engessada. Quando aparece um caminho melhor, ajustamos a rota. A curva de aprendizado é alta: Você não precisa chegar sabendo tudo. Mas precisa querer aprender, se dedicar e evoluir com consistência. Comunicação diária: Você vai ler, escrever, ouvir feedback e precisar pedir ajuda quando travar, em vez de sumir com o problema. Sua parte na ponte (O que você traz para o estágio): Nós não exigimos experiência prévia de mercado, mas exigimos uma base sólida de atitude:
Matrícula ativa e atestada : a partir do 3º ano de qualquer curso de graduação (Exatas, Humanas ou Biológicas). Disponibilidade e curiosidade : 6 horas por dia (30h semanais). Afinidade com tecnologia: não irá programar, só não pode ter medo de fuçar em softwares novos e plataformas web. A matéria-prima do Gerente de Si (Autorresponsabilidade): não é saber gestão de tempo e ter inteligência emocional, isso faz parte do que vamos ensinar. Mas precisa trazer humildade para ouvir, coragem para sinalizar quando travar e disposição para assumir responsabilidade pelo próprio desenvolvimento. Benefits Como apoiamos a sua jornada? Com a infraestrutura para a ponte do crescimento: Bolsa + Benefícios: R$ 1.950,00 (R$ 1.200 + R$ 750). Auxílio transporte : flexível conforme a sua necessidade de deslocamento. Trabalho Híbrido: pelo menos 3x por semana no nosso QG em Barão Geraldo, perto da Unicamp. Kumbatia e Cumbu Chuva: investimos o nosso tempo na sua formação adicionando clube do livro e treinamentos internos. Flexibilidade real: Sabemos como é a semana de provas e imprevistos. Ajustamos os horários baseados no seu cronograma escolar.

title: Business development intern
description:
What your new challenge will look like
This internship is a great opportunity for students who want to develop commercial skills within a global organization.
As a Business Development Intern, you will support the Corporate Sales team in driving impact across all 4flow business lines worldwide by prospecting and reaching out to potential customers in Europe, North America, and Brazil. Your main activities will include:
Prospecting potential new customers
Keeping CRM data up to date
Supporting outreach to potential customers during events through email, phone calls, and Linked In messages
Proactively researching new solutions available in the market to improve sales performance
Why you belong at 4flow Currently studying Business Administration, Engineering, Supply Chain, International Relations or a related field.
Strong interest in sales, logistics, and especially in engaging with people per phone call, Linked In and email. 
Structured, detail-oriented, and proactive mindset.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Intermediate Power Point skills with good visual sense.
Basic knowledge of Excel and Microsoft 365.
Advanced English.
Familiarity with design tools or BI tools is a plus, but not mandatory.
You are available to work 6 hours per day with a minimum 1-year contract.
You are available to work in a hybrid model at our Campinas office (three times per week).
What we offer
As an intern in a highly international and fast-growing company with a vibrant corporate culture, you will gain hands-on experience, develop valuable skills, and be part of a supportive, collaborative team. 
Come join us! At 4flow, you’ll find a clearly defined vision, a dynamic learning environment, and excellent opportunities for your professional growth and also and a great benefits package that includes: 
Caju multi-benefit card 
Fuel or transportation allowance 
Comprehensive health and dental plans fully covered for employees and dependents 
Life insurance 
Comprehensive well-being initiatives, including Wellhub, our Employee Assistance Program for mental health, and dedicated committees for health and well-being 
Outstanding opportunities for your individual development (e.g., access to Linked In Learning and internal training program) 
Hybrid working model for flexibility and work-life balance 
And there is more! 
Company with German roots that offers a clearly defined vision and job security
Team events and company getaways 
Free fruit, snacks, drinks, and coffee at the office

title: Banco de talentos kryptus
description:
Kryptus sem barreiras. O home office chegou para ficar e a distância física não impede você fazer parte do time Kryptus! Com sede no Brasil e filial na Suíça, crescemos de forma consistente há 21 anos, atendendo clientes do setor público e privado na América Latina, Europa, Oriente Médio e África. Inovação está em nosso DNA . Inovamos constantemente para estar sempre à frente das ameaças, evoluindo nossos produtos, aprimorando a qualidade de nossos serviços e realizando projetos sob medida para organizações e nações ao redor do mundo. Venha fazer parte de um time reconhecido no Brasil e no mundo . Conquistamos o status de “Empresa Estratégica de Defesa – EED” pelo Conselho de Defesa Nacional e já fomos nomeados “Cool Vendor 2014 in Brazil” pelo Gartner Institute.  Nosso propósito é habilitar causas e missões que busquem o bem maior. title: Assistente de compras - moda
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA
Sobre a Peça Rara Quer trabalhar na rede de brechós mais sustentável do Brasil?
Com 16 anos de atuação no mercado e mais de 65 lojas espalhadas pelo Brasil, a rede de Brechós Peça Rara com já nasceu com o propósito da reutilização de roupas como forma de promover a sustentabilidade e é prova do sucesso da chamada economia circular.
Com a mudança nos hábitos de consumo, a procura pela moda sustentável subiu exponencialmente nos últimos anos e a tendência é só aumentar. A rede espera dobrar os pontos de vendas até o fim de 2024 para atender a demanda.
Se você deseja promover mudanças significativas e tangíveis no mundo e se considera um profissional que se realiza em um ambiente de trabalho desafiador, esse é o lugar certo para você!
Sobre a vaga: Não vendemos produtos usados: estimulamos e incentivamos novos valores e hábitos de consumo, o que é essencial para um mundo mais sustentável. Responsabilidades: Atender e explicar sobre o contrato de fornecedores;

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

DESCRIÇÃO DA FUNÇÃO:
Tratativa de Contas Particulares
Responsável pela análise, regularização e saneamento de contas particulares, garantindo a correta cobrança, classificação e destinação financeira, bem como a integridade das informações nos sistemas corporativos.

Documentação e Análise:
Realizar a busca por históricos de cobrança e/ou criação das contas, identificando possíveis pagamentos efetuados e não registrados, assegurando a consistência das informações financeiras.
Inserção e Acompanhamento no COBMAIS:
Gerar títulos para migração das contas ao sistema COBMAIS, acompanhando o processo na ferramenta até a efetiva entrega da conta ao corporativo, garantindo o correto fluxo de cobrança.
Protocolo de Perdas (Cortesias, Retornos e Não Pagantes):
Identificar contas não passíveis de cobrança, consolidando-as em protocolo único para encaminhamento à diretoria, visando a solicitação de baixa financeira conforme critérios estabelecidos.
Limpeza de Contas Zeradas:
Executar a exclusão de contas com valor zerado, promovendo a redução do volume de contas não remetidas na base e realizando o apontamento de ajustes necessários para correção definitiva das inconsistências.
Ajustes de Contas Convênio (Particular Diferença):
Analisar contas classificadas como “particular-diferença”, verificando a pertinência da cobrança e realizando os ajustes necessários, como baixa, geração de título ou alteração de fonte pagadora, além do apontamento de melhorias para prevenção de recorrências.

title: Site reliability engineering manager
description:
About the Team
SRE Middleware & Data (SRE M&D) enables product teams by providing secure, scalable, and automated data, middleware, and AI services on Azure.
Provisioning: Automates secure delivery of databases, queues, caches, and AI services/resources; builds self-service andguardrails.
Reliability: Ensures availability, performance, and resilience of data, middleware, and AI services in production; builds observability, autohealing, and disaster recovery.
What You Will Do
Lead and grow the team: Manage, mentor, and develop SRE engineers across Provisioning and Reliability.
Lead cross-team initiatives:
Align roadmaps with Architects and partner teams; ensure adoption of architecture standards.
Run design reviews and architecture signoffs; surface and mitigate risks and complexity early.
Translate standards into guardrails and automation (policyascode, selfservice) for consistent delivery.
Apply lightweight RACI and clear escalation paths to resolve tradeoffs quickly.
Drive roadmap and execution:
Provisioning: Self-service engines, Crossplane/Terraform-based automation, policy-as-code, secured pipelines, access management, backups/restore, Azure AI resource provisioning, and quota management.
Reliability: Observability integrations (New Relic, Azure Monitor), performance tuning, autohealing, DR/BCP, resilience testing, failover automation, SLOs, reliability for Azure AI services and messaging platforms (Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus).
Establish engineering excellence:
Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Crossplane) and CI/CD best practices.
Change management with safe deploys and rollback strategies.
Incident and problem management with blameless postmortems.
Continuous improvement loops measured by DORA/SRE metrics.
Champion security and compliance by design:
Policy as code, least privilege access, and secrets/identity hygiene.
Guardrails in self-service flows; auditability and evidence collection.
Partnership with Security/Compliance for standards and reviews.
Partner with the Architects:
Codevelop platform architecture and service standards.
Define SLIs/SLOs and capacity/reliability patterns for core services.
Align roadmaps and run design reviews for high-impact changes.
Own delivery outcomes:
Navigate competing priorities across a broad platform scope — balancing reactive operational load (incidents, toil, on-call) against proactive platform investment (self-service, automation, resilience) without a clean separation between the two.
Make and communicate prioritization decisions under ambiguity, with partial information, across teams that have conflicting urgency.
Maintain a defensible, visible backlog that reflects real risk and business impact — not just the loudest stakeholder.
Operate a healthy on-call:
High-quality playbooks and automation-first troubleshooting (AI-assisted).
Actionable alerts with SLO-based paging and noise reduction.
Regular resilience testing and post-incident hardening.
Initiatives You Will Lead:
Self-service provisioning for databases, queues, and caches with golden configurations and policy guardrails.
AI-assisted troubleshooting for provisioning and production incidents.
Platform wide observability integration for data, middleware, and AI services (New Relic, Azure Monitor).
Automated DR runbooks and resilience/chaos testing in production.
Performance tuning at service and query layers, including automated tuning workflows.
Standardization of provisioning via Terraform/Crossplane for databases, messaging, and AI services.
Governance for Azure AI services (quotas, access, safety guardrails) with clear consumption patterns for product teams.
Success Metrics
Reduced MTTR and incident count, improved SLO attainment for data/middleware services.
Improved lead time for change and change failure rate; increased automation coverage and reduced toil.
Faster time to provision and higher first success rate for self-service requests.
Measurable improvements in cost efficiency, performance, and capacity predictability.
Team health: engagement, growth, hiring velocity, stress levels, and retention.
SLO attainment for AI endpoints and messaging services; reduced alert noise viaimproved observability (New Relic/Azure Monitor).
What You Will Bring
Proven experience managing SRE/platform/infrastructure teams delivering production-critical services.
Deep familiarity with Azure and the team stack: Postgre SQL, Mongo DB, Cosmos DB; Redis; messaging systems such as Cloud AMQP/Rabbit MQ, Kafka, Event Hubs, and Service Bus.
Strong reliability fundamentals: SLOs/SLIs, incident and problem management, capacity, DR/BCP, performance tuning.
Solid automation background: Ia C (Terraform/Crossplane), CI/CD (Azure Dev Ops), Git Ops, policyascode, secrets and identity, RBAC.
Track record of building selfservice platforms and reducing toil.
Excellent crossfunctional leadership with product, security, and compliance partners.
Experience operating Azure AI services in production (Azure Open AI, Cognitive Services, AI Search).
Observability experience with New Relic, Azure Monitor, and Open Telemetry.
What You’ll Need
Advanced skills in English
Experience with AI-assisted operations and troubleshooting.
Observability expertise (Prometheus/Grafana, New Relic, Azure Monitor, Open Telemetry).
Database performance engineering and query optimization.
Experience in regulated environments and security frameworks.
Fin Ops capabilities (cost governance, forecasting, rightsizing, quotas, budgets, chargeback/showback).
How We Work
Collaboration first with a strong partnership between the Engineering Manager and the Architects.
Automation by default; security and reliability are nonnegotiable.
Blameless postmortems, continuous learning, and measurable outcomes.
Participation in an equitable on-call rotation with high-quality runbooks and automation.
Tech Environment
Azure (AKS, managed databases, storage, networking, identity).
Azure AI services (Azure Open AI, Cognitive Services, AI Search).
Azure Dev Ops for CI/CD.
Cloud AMQP (Rabbit MQ).
Databases: Postgre SQL, Mongo DB, Cosmos DB.
Caches: Redis.
Queues/Brokers: Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus.
Terraform/Crossplane, Git Ops.
Observability: New Relic, Azure Monitor, logs, metrics, traces, alerting workflows.

Descrição

A Fundação FEAC é uma organização da sociedade civil, com sede em Campinas/SP, que há mais de seis décadas atua na promoção da equidade e do desenvolvimento social sustentável. O Gerente de Tecnologia da Informação liderará a estratégia e a operação de tecnologia da FEAC, assegurando a confiabilidade dos serviços de TI, a evolução da arquitetura de dados, a integração entre sistemas, a segurança da informação e a adoção responsável de inteligência artificial nas áreas corporativas e finalísticas. Conduzirá portfólios de projetos complexos (PMBOK/Agile), alinhados aos objetivos de negócio, com foco em eficiência operacional, inovação e geração de dados para mensuração de impacto.

Responsabilidades

  • Estratégia e Escala: Definir e executar a estratégia de TI alinhada ao plano de expansão da Fundação, garantindo que a infraestrutura suporte o aumento do volume de operações aplicações, integrações, infraestrutura, serviços, segurança, dados e capacidades analíticas suportem a expansão institucional, a integração entre áreas e o aumento da complexidade operacional.
  • Transformação Digital: Liderar o diagnóstico, seleção e implementação de novas soluções de gestão (ERP, CRM e sistemas de gestão de projetos sociais) para substituir sistemas legados. Garantir que diagnósticos, arquiteturas, business cases e recomendações sejam traduzidos em decisões executáveis.
  • Gestão de Projetos: Gerenciar o portfólio de projetos estratégicos utilizando práticas do PMI e frameworks ágeis para garantir entregas rápidas e incrementais.
  • Dados e Impacto: Liderar a estratégia de Data Analytics (BI) para suporte à tomada de decisão e geração de relatórios de transparência e impacto para o Conselho e demais públicos de interesse, assegurando a evolução da arquitetura de dados integrada, com princípios fundamentais de Governança de Dados.
  • Compliance e LGPD: Estabelecer a Governança de TI e o compliance de dados, garantindo a plena adequação à LGPD, especialmente no trato de dados sensíveis de beneficiários.
  • AI e Automação: Definir e liderar a estratégia institucional de uso de AI, GenAI e Agentic AI na FEAC, priorizando casos de uso com valor para TI e para as áreas de negócio, com governança, segurança, rastreabilidade, supervisão humana e aderência às políticas institucionais.
  • Gestão de Terceiros: Gerenciar o ecossistema de parceiros e fornecedores externos (SaaS, consultorias e outsourcing), garantindo o cumprimento de SLAs e qualidade técnica e conformidade com a arquitetura definida.
  • Gestão Financeira: Gerenciar o orçamento da área (CAPEX/OPEX), focando na otimização de custos e priorizando investimentos de alto retorno institucional.
  • Liderança de Equipe: Desenvolver o time técnico e promover uma cultura voltada ao atendimento do usuário interno e à inovação.

Requisitos

  • Formação: Superior em TI, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou MBA desejável.
  • Experiência: Sólida trajetória em gestão de TI, preferencialmente em organizações que passaram por processos de modernização ou crescimento acelerado.
  • Conhecimento Técnico: Domínio de Governança de TI (ITIL/COBIT), segurança cibernética e metodologias híbridas (Cascade + Ágil).
  • Projetos: Experiência comprovada na liderança de implantação de sistemas de gestão (ERP/CRM).
  • Certificações: PMP (Project Management Professional) ou equivalente fortemente desejável.
  • Idiomas: Inglês fluente/avançado.

title: Engineering Design Specialist - 72123
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L

Job Overview:

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals.
  • Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance.

Domain Tracks:

You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g;
expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus.

  • Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems.
  • Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design.
  • Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry.
  • Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification.
  • Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design.
  • Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference.
  • Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads.
  • Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design.
  • Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design.
  • Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration.
  • Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration.

Required Qualifications:

  • Master's or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis).
  • Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain.
  • Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills.
  • High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor

Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‐onboarding requirements.

After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field;
    postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills;
    fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Data Operations Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world's top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It's Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn't a place for coasting—it's a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you'll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You'll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you've been waiting for.

About The Role:

The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.

As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:

  • Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
  • Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
  • Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
  • Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
  • Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.

You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have...

  • 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
  • Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
  • The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
  • High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).

Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):

  • Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

Kindly submit your application and CV in English.
